written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Robin has a hidden goodwill score: insults lower it by 1, while apologies and gifts raise it by 1; he is warm only if the final score is positive.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Robin counts only apologies and insults; gifts do not affect his final mood, and he is warm exactly when apologies outnumber insults.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Robin starts cold; an apology can warm him, but any occurrence of two insults in a row makes him stay cold for the whole observation.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Robin tracks an invisible grudge debt: insults add debt and cool him; apologies clear up to one point of debt and warm only if the debt was small; gifts reduce debt, but only a gift with no debt makes him warm.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Robin accumulates a hidden warmth score: insults -4, apologies +2, gifts +1; warm iff the final score is positive.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Robin tracks an invisible grudge debt; insults add 1. Apologies clear all debt, but only warm him if the debt was at most 1; otherwise he stays cold. Gifts remove 1 debt and warm only if he had no debt before the gift.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Robin tracks a grudge debt; insults add 1. Apologies forgive debt 0 or 1 and warm him, but if he is already deeply angry (debt at least 2), an apology adds another grudge and leaves him cold. Gifts remove 1 debt and warm only if he had no debt before the gift.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Robin's final mood depends on his last action and the run of consecutive insults immediately before it: ending with an insult is always cold; ending with a gift is warm only if no insult immediately precedes it; ending with an apology is warm if at most one insult immediately precedes it.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Robin tracks a grudge debt; insults add 1. Apologies forgive debt 0 or 1 and warm, but add a grudge if debt>=2. Gifts remove 2 debt (or all remaining) and stay cold if any debt existed, otherwise warm.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Robin tracks a grudge debt; insults add 1. Apologies warm and clear debt up to 1, but if debt is already at least 2 an apology leaves debt at 2 and stays cold. Gifts remove 1 debt and stay cold if any debt existed, otherwise warm.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Robin tracks a grudge debt; insults add 1. Apologies warm and clear debt up to 1, but if debt is already at least 2 an apology leaves debt at 2 and stays cold. Gifts remove 2 debt (or all remaining) and stay cold if any debt existed, otherwise warm.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Robin tracks a grudge debt; insults add 1. Apologies warm and clear debt up to 1, but add a grudge if debt is at least 2. Gifts reset any debt to 0 and stay cold if there was debt, otherwise warm.

survivors.name: round 2 rival 3
survivors.comment: Robin tracks a grudge debt; insults add 1. Apologies forgive debt 0 or 1 and warm him, but if he is already deeply angry (debt at least 2), an apology adds another grudge and leaves him cold. Gifts remove 1 debt and warm only if he had no debt before the gift.

survivors.name: round 3 rival 2
survivors.comment: Robin tracks a grudge debt; insults add 1. Apologies warm and clear debt up to 1, but if debt is already at least 2 an apology leaves debt at 2 and stays cold. Gifts remove 1 debt and stay cold if any debt existed, otherwise warm.

shown the survivors.comment: Robin tracks a grudge debt: insults add 1; apologies clear debt 0-1 and warm, but if debt >= 2 they set it to 2 and stay cold; gifts remove 1 debt and warm only if there was no debt.

shown the facts only.comment: Robin has hidden anger 0/1/2+: insults raise it (capped at 2), apologise clears only anger 1 to 0, gifts do nothing; warm iff anger is 0.
